name: my_store_ui
description: Bench app-root package.json. Its sole purpose is to hook into bench's existing 'yarn install --check-files' step (run automatically for any app with a root package.json) so the postinstall script below builds the nested Vue/Vite SPA in frontend/ during the Docker image build, before bench's final asset-linking pass copies my_store_ui/public/* into sites/assets/my_store_ui/.

scripts.postinstall: cd frontend && yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn build
